rationale: The fixed implementation changes error handling by returning immediately when bitmap retrieval or the copy to user space fails, whereas the vulnerable implementation accumulates errors and may continue to allocation/copy after a retrieval failure. The Logic section describes the common high-level sequence—bitmap sizing, user-space bitmap handling when a mask is supplied, copying, and invoking the underlying policy syscall—but does not specify either immediate failure handling or continued processing after an error. Its statements are therefore abstract enough to apply to both versions.
